response.sql: WITH base_data AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, ili.product_price, CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END as cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id), item_town_averages AS (SELECT order_item_id, town_city, AVG(product_price) as avg_product_price, AVG(cost_ratio) as avg_cost_ratio FROM base_data GROUP BY order_item_id, town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_product_price) as town_avg_price, AVG(avg_cost_ratio) as town_avg_cost_ratio FROM item_town_averages GROUP BY town_city), global_average AS (SELECT AVG(town_avg_cost_ratio) as global_avg_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT ta.town_city, ta.town_avg_price, ta.town_avg_cost_ratio, ta.town_avg_cost_ratio - ga.global_avg_ratio as ratio_excess FROM town_averages ta CROSS JOIN global_average ga WHERE ta.town_avg_cost_ratio > ga.global_avg_ratio
